description: A chart the apps draw natively (interactive, themed). Caps: 8 series; 500 points per series and 2000 in total; 100 categories; pie 12 slices and one series; 12 annotations; the whole object under 32 KB.

subtitle.description: Source, sample size, period: the muted line under the title.

points.description: line | area | scatter: [x, y] pairs. x is a number, or an ISO-8601 date / date-time string (then x.scale is time). y null = a gap.

values.description: bar | pie: one value per category, in order. null = no bar.

color.description: Optional. Omit for the theme palette; a given colour is kept as-is in both themes.

axis.description: right = a second value axis (its unit from y2).

categories.description: bar | pie: the category (bar) or slice labels; each series then gives `values`, one per category.

stacked.description: bar | area: stack the series instead of grouping them.

legend.description: auto = shown when there is more than one series.

unit.description: Shown on ticks and in the readout: %, ms, $, GB …

format.description: percent expects 0–100 values; compact = 1.2k / 3.4M; duration = seconds.
